title: 第七章 且听剑鸣第八章 镇北王
content_zh:
“怎么可能？他只是下品灵根，这才过去多长时间？竟然到了炼气四层。”
李红艳一阵口干舌燥，声音透着难以形容的尖锐，眼睛里面充满了不可置信之色。
陈君浩则是瞳孔猛地一缩，不由自主地吞了一口唾沫。
萧凉面色苍白，但双眼澄澈清明，他能挡住天罡境巅峰恐怖一击，也是在意料之外的。
灵力化罡是力量进一步发生质的变化，蕴含何等威势他可是清楚明白的。
从这里可以看得出来“无量剑道”是何等恐怖，异变的剑灵根是何等恐怖。
这一瞬间，萧凉才算是彻底有了在这方世界立足下去的底气。
吐出一口浊气，萧凉运转“无量剑道”，解开一道封印的无量剑与丹田气海中的灵力形成一种莫名的共鸣。
萧凉的气势，在这时候节节攀升。
天罡境巅峰的高手见状，眼中充满了震惊之色。
那一击之力有多恐怖，他比谁都清楚。
一个炼气四层的蝼蚁，怎么可能抵挡得住？这简直太邪门了。
正当这时，李红艳已经回过神来，她目光不住变化，思绪在不住变化。
“雨涵去了凌霄阁，凭着极品灵根现在也才是炼气五层，他是如何修炼到炼气四层的？”
“不行，此子太过诡异，断不可留！”李红艳看向萧凉，眼中射出两道寒芒，站起身来，“今日若是你敢与世子为敌，我苏家断然不会管你！”
陈君浩嘴角掀起微微弧度，他大笑一声，指着萧凉说道：“若是没有苏家，我踩死你就像是踩死一只蚂蚁一般简单。”
萧凉擦掉嘴角鲜血，体内伤势恢复得七七八八的，他迎上李红艳的目光，“若苏家是你做主，我萧凉自然无话可说。”
“我说过，苏家的主，我能做！”李红艳背负双手，盛气凌人。
“好一个忘恩负义的苏家！”萧凉冷哼一声，他本不想这般快与苏家撕破脸皮的。
“我苏家照顾了你五年，该还的早就还完了！”李红艳冷哼一声，一股庞然气势陡然爆发，“你携恩要挟，苏继可以忍你，但是我李红艳不能忍你！”

“哈哈哈！”陈君浩忽然发出一声大笑，嘴角掀起戏谑之色，“看来这颗让人讨厌的老鼠屎很影响心情，不如我替夫人打扫干净吧！”
李红艳不置可否，眼中光芒无比凌厉，她本就是要借刀杀人解决掉萧凉，之前已经给了陈君浩暗示，就算陈君浩在此杀了萧凉，苏家也不会管。
在陈君浩示意之下，天罡境巅峰高手再次出手，浑厚的灵力漫涌而来，萧凉顿然生出难以形容的窒息感。
“穿越而来五年，在苏家每日都过着如履薄冰的日子，生怕行差踏错，就丢了小命。”
“多少个午夜，被噩梦惊醒。”
“多少个日子，面临抉择之时犹豫再犹豫，生怕眼前看到的机会，是别人挖好的陷阱。”
“我已经都小心翼翼了，已经够低调了，够没有存在感了，甚至在某些时候，突破了自己该有的底线而委曲求全，可是，为什么还是会有这许多的烂事？为什么还是避不开这些纷纷扰扰？为什么你们还是不放过我？”
“苏家要我的命，李家要我的命，而今这陈君浩还是要我的命，难道我萧凉只能是任人欺凌宰割的蝼蚁，不能有半点怨言？不能有任何反抗？”
content_en:
"How is that possible? He only has a low-grade spiritual root. How long has it been? He has actually reached the fourth level of Qi Refining."
Li Hongyan's mouth went dry for a while, her voice was indescribably sharp, and her eyes were filled with disbelief.
Chen Junhao's pupils shrank suddenly and he swallowed involuntarily.
Xiao Liang's face was pale, but his eyes were clear and clear. It was unexpected that he could block the terrifying blow from the peak of Tiangang Realm.
The transformation of spiritual power into Gang is a further qualitative change in power, and he clearly understands the power it contains.
From here we can see how terrifying the "Infinite Sword Dao" is, and how terrifying the mutated sword spirit root is.
At this moment, Xiao Liang finally had the confidence to establish himself in this world.
Exhaling a breath of turbid air, Xiao Liang activated the "Infinite Sword Technique", and the Infinite Sword that unlocked a seal formed an inexplicable resonance with the spiritual power in the Dantian Qi sea.
Xiao Liang's momentum was rising steadily at this time.
The masters at the top of the Tiangang Realm saw this, and their eyes were filled with shock.
He knew better than anyone how terrifying that blow was.
How could an ant at the fourth level of Qi Refining be able to resist? This is simply too evil.
At this moment, Li Hongyan had come to her senses. Her eyes and thoughts kept changing.
"Yu Han went to Lingxiao Pavilion. He is only at the fifth level of Qi Refining with his top-quality spiritual roots. How did he reach the fourth level of Qi Refining?"
"No, this son is too weird, we must not keep him!" Li Hongyan looked at Xiao Liang, with two cold gleams in her eyes, and stood up, "If you dare to be an enemy of the prince today, my Su family will definitely not care about you!"
The corners of Chen Junhao's mouth curved slightly, he laughed, pointed at Xiao Liang and said, "If it weren't for the Su family, I would trample you to death as easily as an ant."
Xiao Liang wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and the injuries in his body were fully recovered. He met Li Hongyan's gaze and said, "If you are the one who makes the decision in the Su family, I, Xiao Liang, will naturally have nothing to say."
"I said, the head of the Su family, I can do it!" Li Hongyan put her hands behind her back and looked domineering.
"What an ungrateful Su family!" Xiao Liang snorted coldly. He didn't want to break up with the Su family so quickly.
"I, the Su family, have taken care of you for five years, and I have already paid you back!" Li Hongyan snorted coldly, and a majestic aura suddenly erupted, "You threaten with kindness, Su Ji can tolerate you, but I, Li Hongyan, cannot tolerate you!"
"Hahaha!" Chen Junhao suddenly burst into laughter, with a joking look on his lips, "It seems that this annoying rat droppings is really affecting my mood. Why don't I clean it up for Madam!"
Li Hongyan was noncommittal, the light in her eyes was extremely sharp. She wanted to kill Xiao Liang with a borrowed knife. She had already given Chen Junhao a hint before that even if Chen Junhao killed Xiao Liang here, the Su family would not care.
At Chen Junhao's signal, the master at the top of the Tiangang Realm took action again, and powerful spiritual power surged in. Xiao Liang suddenly felt an indescribable suffocation.
"Five years since I traveled back in time, I have been walking on thin ice every day in the Su family. I was afraid that I would lose my life if I made the wrong move."
"How many midnights have I been awakened by nightmares?"
"How many days have I hesitated again and again when faced with a decision? I'm afraid that the opportunity I see in front of me is a trap dug by others."
"I have been careful enough, low-key enough, and have no sense of presence. At certain times, I have even exceeded my own bottom line and compromised myself. But why do so many bad things still happen? Why can't I avoid these disturbances? Why don't you let me go?"
"The Su family wants my life, the Li family wants my life, and now Chen Junhao still wants my life. Could it be that I, Xiao Liang, can only be an ant that is bullied and slaughtered by others, without the slightest complaint? Without any resistance?"
